parts.label: (b)
(c)(i)
parts.stem:
But-1-ene reacts with steam as shown to form a mixture of two structural isomers, **S** and **T**.

{{figure:pdf_visual_03.png}}

**S** can be oxidised with acidified potassium dichromate(VI) to form compound **U**.

**S** and **U** both react with alkaline aqueous iodine.
parts.text: Identify the *type of reaction* that occurs when but-1-ene reacts with steam.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: State what can be deduced about the structure of **S** from its reaction with alkaline aqueous iodine.

parts.label: (c)(iii)
parts.text: Explain why **S** is the major product of the reaction of but-1-ene with steam.

parts.label: (c)(v)
parts.text:
Write an equation to represent the oxidation of **S** to **U** by acidified potassium dichromate(VI).

You should use [O] to represent the oxidising agent.

parts.label: (d)(i)
parts.stem:
$\text{CH}_3(\text{CH}_2)_3\text{CO}_2\text{H}$ is a colourless liquid with an unpleasant odour.

It reacts with methanol in the presence of an acid catalyst to produce an organic product **V**, which has a pleasant fruity smell.
